description: This file defines a 'ProductGrid' component using Lightning JS, which renders a grid of product cards based on provided product data.

classes.name: ProductGrid
classes.description: A Lightning JS component that displays a grid of product cards, configurable with number of rows, columns, and product data.

methods.name: $index
methods.description: Calculates a linear index from row and column indices.

methods.name: $productAt
methods.description: Retrieves the product at a specified row and column.

methods.name: $rowY
methods.description: Calculates the y-position of a row based on its index.

methods.name: $colX
methods.description: Calculates the x-position of a column based on its index.
